purpose.zh: 扶椅练单腿髋铰链，强化臀部和大腿后侧
purpose.en: Practise a supported single-leg hinge to build glutes and hamstrings.

text.zh: 支撑膝微屈，背部平直从髋部前倾
text.en: Soften the standing knee and hinge forward from the hip with a flat back

text.zh: 一手扶稳椅背，后腿跟着躯干抬起
text.en: Hold the chair back and let the free leg rise in line with your trunk.

text.zh: 小幅度前倾，再慢慢站直
text.en: Hinge a little, then slowly stand back up.

cautions.zh: 扶稳无轮的椅子，疼痛或站不稳时就停止
cautions.en: Hold a stable chair without wheels, and stop if it hurts or you feel unsteady.
